caption: Figure 1: Conditional adversarial net
description:
## Figure Description
This figure is a diagram illustrating a conditional adversarial network, specifically a Conditional Generative Adversarial Net (cGAN). It shows two main components: a Generator and a Discriminator. The Generator takes a latent vector z and a label y to produce a synthetic data point x. The Discriminator takes a data point x and a label y to determine if x is real or generated. Both components are connected through a shared label y, indicating the conditional nature of the network.

## Figure Content
Text in figure: "Discriminator", "D(x|y)", "Generator", "G(z|y)", "x", "y", "z". Components: Generator, Discriminator, x, y, z. Connections: Generator outputs x, Discriminator inputs x and y. Labels: "x" and "y" are used in both Generator and Discriminator.

caption: Figure 2: Generated MNIST digits, each row conditioned on one label
description:
Figure Description: The image displays a grid of handwritten digits, each row representing digits from 0 to 9. Each digit is generated by a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) conditioned on a specific label. The digits are handwritten and vary in style and clarity, showcasing the GAN's ability to generate diverse digit images.

Text in Figure: The text in the figure includes the digits 0 through 9, each repeated multiple times in a row, corresponding to the generated digits for each label.
